S.FORM: I pituay ku tuki tayra tu kaku i cacudadan.
I pituay ku tuki tayra tu kaku i cacudadan.
S.PHON: i pit[o|u]aj k[o|u] t[o|u]ki tajra t[o|u] kak[o|u] i ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan
S.TRANSL: 我今天七點到學校。
I arrived at school at seven today.

S.FORM: Malingatu tu a micudad! cumudsa ku pasevana'ay, suwal satu ku pangcang, "katemireng! micemek!"
Malingatu tu a micudad! cumudsa ku pasevana'ay, suwal satu ku pangcang, "katemireng! micemek!"
S.PHON: maɾiŋat[o|u] t[o|u] a miʦ[o|u]dad ʦ[o|u]m[o|u]dsa k[o|u] pasə[b|v]anaʡaj s[o|u]waɾ sat[o|u] k[o|u] paŋʦaŋ katəmirəŋ miʦəmək
S.TRANSL: 開始上課了!老師剛走進教室時，班長說:「起立!敬禮!」
It’s time for class , the teacher walked into the classroom, and the monitor said, “Stand up! Salute!”

S.FORM: Tataang ku nipangiha niyam, "Kapah haw kisu pasevana'ay?"
Tataang ku nipangiha niyam, "Kapah haw kisu pasevana'ay?"
S.PHON: tataaŋ k[o|u] nipaŋiħa nijam kapaħ ħaw kis[o|u] pasə[b|v]anaʡaj
S.TRANSL: 我們大聲的說:「老師好。」
We said loudly, “Hi, teacher.”

S.FORM: I nipicudad, pasevana'an nu pasevana'ay kami tu sasausian nu Pangcah a suwal.
I nipicudad, pasevana'an nu pasevana'ay kami tu sasausian nu Pangcah a suwal.
S.PHON: i nipiʦ[o|u]dad pasə[b|v]anaʡan n[o|u] pasə[b|v]anaʡaj kami t[o|u] sasa[o|u]sian n[o|u] paŋʦaħ a s[o|u]waɾ
S.TRANSL: 上課的時候，老師教我們數字的阿美族語。
In class, the teacher taught us the Pangcah language of numbers.

S.FORM: Duduen niyam ku pasevana'ay a remadiw tu sapisa'usi a radiw.
Duduen niyam ku pasevana'ay a remadiw tu sapisa'usi a radiw.
S.PHON: d[o|u]d[o|u]ən nijam k[o|u] pasə[b|v]anaʡaj a rəmadiw t[o|u] sapisaʡ[o|u]si a radiw
S.TRANSL: 我們跟著老師唸，我們唱了數字歌。
We followed the teacher to read, we sang the number song.

S.FORM: Adihay tu ku nikavana'an nu maku tu suwal nu Pangcah.
Adihay tu ku nikavana'an nu maku tu suwal nu Pangcah.
S.PHON: adiħaj t[o|u] k[o|u] nika[b|v]anaʡan n[o|u] mak[o|u] t[o|u] s[o|u]waɾ n[o|u] paŋʦaħ
S.TRANSL: 我學會好多族語。
I have learned many Pangcah languages.

S.FORM: A patengil kaku ci inaan tu nipinanam tu suwal nu Pangcah i cacudadan tu remiremiad.
A patengil kaku ci inaan tu nipinanam tu suwal nu Pangcah i cacudadan tu remiremiad.
S.PHON: a patəŋiɾ kak[o|u] ʦi inaan t[o|u] nipinanam t[o|u] s[o|u]waɾ n[o|u] paŋʦaħ i ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan t[o|u] rəmirəmiad
S.TRANSL: 我天天上學，我天天學族語，我要講給媽媽聽。
I go to school every day, I learn the Pangcah language every day, and I want to tell my mother.

S.FORM: Ci Kacaw ku ngangan nu maku.
Ci Kacaw ku ngangan nu maku.
S.PHON: ʦi kaʦaw k[o|u] ŋaŋan n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的名字是kacaw。
My name is kacaw.

S.FORM: Ci Using ku ngangan ni ama nu maku.
Ci Using ku ngangan ni ama nu maku.
S.PHON: ʦi [o|u]siŋ k[o|u] ŋaŋan ni ama n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我爸爸的名字是Using。
My dad’s name is Using.

S.FORM: Ci Panay ku ngangan ni ina nu maku.
Ci Panay ku ngangan ni ina nu maku.
S.PHON: ʦi panaj k[o|u] ŋaŋan ni ina n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我媽媽的名字是Panay。
My mother’s name is Panay.

S.FORM: Muktep tu ku mihcaan nu maku i anini a mihca.
Muktep tu ku mihcaan nu maku i anini a mihca.
S.PHON: m[o|u]ktəp t[o|u] k[o|u] miħʦaan n[o|u] mak[o|u] i anini a miħʦa
S.TRANSL: 我今年10歲。
I am 10 years old.

S.FORM: Sikaka kaku tu vavainay cacay, ci Kulas han cira, savaw tu cacay ku mihcaan nira i anini a mihca.
Sikaka kaku tu vavainay cacay, ci Kulas han cira, savaw tu cacay ku mihcaan nira i anini a mihca.
S.PHON: sikaka kak[o|u] t[o|u] [b|v]a[b|v]ainaj ʦaʦaj ʦi k[o|u]ɾas ħan ʦira sa[b|v]aw t[o|u] ʦaʦaj k[o|u] miħʦaan nira i anini a miħʦa
S.TRANSL: 我有一個哥哥，他叫Kulas，他今年11歲。
I have a brother, his name is kulas, he is 11 years old.

S.FORM: Malecad ku cacudadan niyam.
Malecad ku cacudadan niyam.
S.PHON: maɾəʦad k[o|u] ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan nijam
S.TRANSL: 我們在同一間學校讀書。
We study in the same school.

S.FORM: Maulah kami malekaka a remidiw.
Maulah kami malekaka a remidiw.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kami maɾəkaka a rəmidiw
S.TRANSL: 我和哥哥都喜歡唱歌。
Both my brother and I like to sing.

S.FORM: Maulah kaku a midanguy, i pipantangan maruyaruy tu ku luma' niyam a midanguy.
Maulah kaku a midanguy, i pipantangan maruyaruy tu ku luma' niyam a midanguy.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] a midaŋ[o|u]j i pipantaŋan mar[o|u]jar[o|u]j t[o|u] k[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ nijam a midaŋ[o|u]j
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡游泳，放假的時候，我們全家會一起去游泳。
I like swimming. During the holidays, our whole family go swimming together.

S.FORM: Maulah kaku a sicavay tu valuhay a cavay, malecavay tu kami a remadiw, a midanguy.
Maulah kaku a sicavay tu valuhay a cavay, malecavay tu kami a remadiw, a midanguy.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] a siʦa[b|v]aj t[o|u] [b|v]aɾ[o|u]ħaj a ʦa[b|v]aj maɾəʦa[b|v]aj t[o|u] kami a rəmadiw a midaŋ[o|u]j
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡認識新朋友，我們可以一起唱歌和游泳。
I love meeting new people, we can sing and swim together.

S.FORM: U wawa nu Pangcah kaku.
U wawa nu Pangcah kaku.
S.PHON: [o|u] wawa n[o|u] paŋʦaħ kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我是阿美族的小孩。
I am an ’Amis child.

S.FORM: I Rinahemay ku luma' nu niyam.
I Rinahemay ku luma' nu niyam.
S.PHON: i rinaħəmaj k[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ n[o|u] nijam
S.TRANSL: 我們家住在Rinahem。
Our family lives in Rinahem.

S.FORM: U tamdaw nu luma' nu niyam lalima.
U tamdaw nu luma' nu niyam lalima.
S.PHON: [o|u] tamdaw n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ n[o|u] nijam ɾaɾima
S.TRANSL: 我們家共有五個人。
There are five people in our family.

S.FORM: Tatulu kami a malekaka.
Tatulu kami a malekaka.
S.PHON: tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u] kami a maɾəkaka
S.TRANSL: 我們家有三個兄弟姊妹。
There are three brothers and sisters in our family.

S.FORM: Makumud ku aru' nu maku aci ama, ina, atu kaka tu vavainayan, kaka tu vavahiyan.
Makumud ku aru' nu maku aci ama, ina, atu kaka tu vavainayan, kaka tu vavahiyan.
S.PHON: mak[o|u]m[o|u]d k[o|u] ar[o|u]ʡ n[o|u] mak[o|u] aʦi ama ina at[o|u] kaka t[o|u] [b|v]a[b|v]ainajan kaka t[o|u] [b|v]a[b|v]aħijan
S.TRANSL: 我跟爸爸、媽媽、哥哥和姊姊住在一起。
I live with my father, mother, brother and sister.

S.FORM: Tarakaw ci ama aku, u malakincalay ci ama nu maku.
Tarakaw ci ama aku, u malakincalay ci ama nu maku.
S.PHON: tarakaw ʦi ama ak[o|u] [o|u] maɾakinʦaɾaj ʦi ama n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的爸爸很高，我的爸爸是警察。
My father is tall and he is a policeman.

S.FORM: Makupit ci ina aku, u ising ci ina nu maku.
Makupit ci ina aku, u ising ci ina nu maku.
S.PHON: mak[o|u]pit ʦi ina ak[o|u] [o|u] isiŋ ʦi ina n[o|u] mak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我的媽媽很瘦，我的媽媽是醫生。
My mother is thin and my mom is a doctor.

S.FORM: Anu i luma' tu ci ama, u nu Pangcah tu ku nikasasuwal niyam.
Anu i luma' tu ci ama, u nu Pangcah tu ku nikasasuwal niyam.
S.PHON: an[o|u] i ɾ[o|u]maʡ t[o|u] ʦi ama [o|u] n[o|u] paŋʦaħ t[o|u] k[o|u] nikasas[o|u]waɾ nijam
S.TRANSL: 爸爸在家就會和我們說阿美族語。
My father speaks the Pangcah language with us at home.

S.FORM: I pahanhan nu laludan, taluma' tu kami i niyaru'.
I pahanhan nu laludan, taluma' tu kami i niyaru'.
S.PHON: i paħanħan n[o|u] ɾaɾ[o|u]dan taɾ[o|u]maʡ t[o|u] kami i nijar[o|u]ʡ
S.TRANSL: 我們暑假都會回部落。
We will all go back to the tribe during the summer vacation.

S.FORM: Mahekulung kami a malekaka a milepel tu tatakula'.
Mahekulung kami a malekaka a milepel tu tatakula'.
S.PHON: maħək[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ŋ kami a maɾəkaka a miɾəpəɾ t[o|u] tatak[o|u]ɾaʡ
S.TRANSL: 我和兄姊會一起抓青蛙。
My brothers and sisters and I will catch frogs together.

S.FORM: Maulah kaku tu tamdaw nu luma' nu niyam.
Maulah kaku tu tamdaw nu luma' nu niyam.
S.PHON: ma[o|u]ɾaħ kak[o|u] t[o|u] tamdaw n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ n[o|u] nijam
S.TRANSL: 我很喜歡我們家的人。
I like our family very much.

S.FORM: Tahkal a mihulul kaku aci ina i anini a remiad.
Tahkal a mihulul kaku aci ina i anini a remiad.
S.PHON: taħkaɾ a miħ[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ɾ kak[o|u] aʦi ina i anini a rəmiad
S.TRANSL: 今天我和媽媽出去玩。
I went out with my mother today.

S.FORM: Salangdaw sa ku kakarayan i remiadan, carangcang aca ku remiad.
Salangdaw sa ku kakarayan i remiadan, carangcang aca ku remiad.
S.PHON: saɾaŋdaw sa k[o|u] kakarajan i rəmiadan ʦaraŋʦaŋ aʦa k[o|u] rəmiad
S.TRANSL: 白天的天空很藍，天氣也風和日麗。
The sky is blue during the day, the weather is neither cold nor hot, and the wind is cool.

S.FORM: Maru' kami a kemaen tu pan i sirengusay a seraan, sadiheku saan ku tireng a mapacidal
Maru' kami a kemaen tu pan i sirengusay a seraan, sadiheku saan ku tireng a mapacidal
S.PHON: mar[o|u]ʡ kami a kəmaən t[o|u] pan i sirəŋ[o|u]saj a səraan sadiħək[o|u] saan k[o|u] tirəŋ a mapaʦidaɾ
S.TRANSL: 我們在草地上吃著麵包，陽光灑在身上，非常溫暖。
We ate bread on the grass, the sun was shining on us, and it was very warm.

S.FORM: Salahengan satu ku kakarayan i herek nu kalahukan.
Salahengan satu ku kakarayan i herek nu kalahukan.
S.PHON: saɾaħəŋan sat[o|u] k[o|u] kakarajan i ħərək n[o|u] kaɾaħ[o|u]kan
S.TRANSL: 下午，天空變紅了。
In the afternoon, the sky turned red.

S.FORM: Palitaen nu maku ci ina, kiya u lahngangay saw ku kulit nu kakarayan?
Palitaen nu maku ci ina, kiya u lahngangay saw ku kulit nu kakarayan?
S.PHON: paɾitaən n[o|u] mak[o|u] ʦi ina kija [o|u] ɾaħŋaŋaj saw k[o|u] k[o|u]ɾit n[o|u] kakarajan
S.TRANSL: 我問媽媽，為甚麼天空的顏色是紅色的？
I asked my mother why the sky is red.

S.FORM: Suwal satu ci ina, kay a initu ku valiyus.
Suwal satu ci ina, kay a initu ku valiyus.
S.PHON: s[o|u]waɾ sat[o|u] ʦi ina kaj a init[o|u] k[o|u] [b|v]aɾij[o|u]s
S.TRANSL: 媽媽說，可能是颱風要來了。
Mom said, maybe the typhoon is coming.

S.FORM: Awaay ku kutem i lavii, sadak satu ku vuis.
Awaay ku kutem i lavii, sadak satu ku vuis.
S.PHON: awaaj k[o|u] k[o|u]təm i ɾa[b|v]ii sadak sat[o|u] k[o|u] [b|v][o|u]is
S.TRANSL: 晚上天上沒有雲，星星出來了。
There were no clouds in the sky at night, and the stars came out.

S.FORM: A taluma' tu kita.
A taluma' tu kita.
S.PHON: a taɾ[o|u]maʡ t[o|u] kita
S.TRANSL: 我們也要回家了。
We were going home too.

S.FORM: I vatad tu sakataluma' a lalanan, milunguc kaku tu vuis.
I vatad tu sakataluma' a lalanan, milunguc kaku tu vuis.
S.PHON: i [b|v]atad t[o|u] sakataɾ[o|u]maʡ a ɾaɾanan miɾ[o|u]ŋ[o|u]ʦ kak[o|u] t[o|u] [b|v][o|u]is
S.TRANSL: 在回家的路上，我跟星星許願。
On the way home, I made a wish with the stars,

S.FORM: Akaa katayni ku valiyus nasa kaku, a managlay hen kaku a mihulul kiyami.
Akaa katayni ku valiyus nasa kaku, a managlay hen kaku a mihulul kiyami.
S.PHON: akaa katajni k[o|u] [b|v]aɾij[o|u]s nasa kak[o|u] a mana*ɾaj ħən kak[o|u] a miħ[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ɾ kijami
S.TRANSL: 希望颱風不要來!我還想再出去玩。
I hope the typhoon doesn't come, I still want to go out to play again.

S.FORM: I tapiingan nu luma' ku cacudadan niyam, rakaten nu maku a talacacudadan, rakaten aca a taluma' tu remiremiad.
I tapiingan nu luma' ku cacudadan niyam, rakaten nu maku a talacacudadan, rakaten aca a taluma' tu remiremiad.
S.PHON: i tapiiŋan n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ k[o|u] ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan nijam rakatən n[o|u] mak[o|u] a taɾaʦaʦ[o|u]dadan rakatən aʦa a taɾ[o|u]maʡ t[o|u] rəmirəmiad
S.TRANSL: 我的學校在我們家旁邊，我天天走路去學校，也走路回家。
My school is next to our house, I walk to school every day, and I also walk home.

S.FORM: Caay katataang ku cacudadan nu niyam, caay kaaluman ku micudaday, u masasuvana' tu amin kami.
Caay katataang ku cacudadan nu niyam, caay kaaluman ku micudaday, u masasuvana' tu amin kami.
S.PHON: ʦaaj katataaŋ k[o|u] ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan n[o|u] nijam ʦaaj kaaɾ[o|u]man k[o|u] miʦ[o|u]dadaj [o|u] masas[o|u][b|v]anaʡ t[o|u] amin kami
S.TRANSL: 我們學校不大，沒有很多學生，大家互相認識。
Our school is not big, there are not many students, everyone knows each other.

S.FORM: Malecapu amin ku adiwawa i kavekacan a mimali, a masasuwasuwal.
Malecapu amin ku adiwawa i kavekacan a mimali, a masasuwasuwal.
S.PHON: maɾəʦap[o|u] amin k[o|u] adiwawa i ka[b|v]əkaʦan a mimaɾi a masas[o|u]was[o|u]waɾ
S.TRANSL: 所有小朋友會聚在操場，一起玩球、一起聊天。
All the children will gather in the playground, play ball and chat together.

S.FORM: Mikihatiya ku pasevana'ay i tamiyan a mahekulung a malehulul, matiya sa u malecacayay a luma'an ku cacudadan.
Mikihatiya ku pasevana'ay i tamiyan a mahekulung a malehulul, matiya sa u malecacayay a luma'an ku cacudadan.
S.PHON: mikiħatija k[o|u] pasə[b|v]anaʡaj i tamijan a maħək[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ŋ a maɾəħ[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ɾ matija sa [o|u] maɾəʦaʦajaj a ɾ[o|u]maʡan k[o|u] ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan
S.TRANSL: 老師們也會和我們一起玩，學校是個大家庭。
The teachers also play with us, the school is one big family.

S.FORM: Miasik kami tu remiremiad, satamelac han niyam ku nipiasik tu picudadan.
Miasik kami tu remiremiad, satamelac han niyam ku nipiasik tu picudadan.
S.PHON: miasik kami t[o|u] rəmirəmiad sataməɾaʦ ħan nijam k[o|u] nipiasik t[o|u] piʦ[o|u]dadan
S.TRANSL: 我們每天都要打掃，大家要把教室打掃乾淨。
We have to clean every day, and everyone has to clean the classroom.

S.FORM: Simisipuay tu sasingaran, simiasikay nu rumaan a tamdaw.
Simisipuay tu sasingaran, simiasikay nu rumaan a tamdaw.
S.PHON: simisip[o|u]aj t[o|u] sasiŋaran simiasikaj n[o|u] r[o|u]maan a tamdaw
S.TRANSL: 有些人去擦窗戶，另外,有些人去掃地。
Some people clean the windows, some sweep the floor.

S.FORM: Miasik aca kami tu karimucumucuan nu cacudadan, matatahic kami a malalikel a demak, satamelac satu ku cacudadan tu remiremiad.
Miasik aca kami tu karimucumucuan nu cacudadan, matatahic kami a malalikel a demak, satamelac satu ku cacudadan tu remiremiad.
S.PHON: miasik aʦa kami t[o|u] karim[o|u]ʦ[o|u]m[o|u]ʦ[o|u]an n[o|u] ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan matataħiʦ kami a maɾaɾikəɾ a dəmak sataməɾaʦ sat[o|u] k[o|u] ʦaʦ[o|u]dadan t[o|u] rəmirəmiad
S.TRANSL: 我們還會打掃學校的各個角落，大家分工合作，學校每天都很乾淨。
We will also clean every corner of the school. Everyone works together, and the school is very clean every day.

S.FORM: Natayra kaku i niyaru' a milisu' ci vakian i nacila.
Natayra kaku i niyaru' a milisu' ci vakian i nacila.
S.PHON: natajra kak[o|u] i nijar[o|u]ʡ a miɾis[o|u]ʡ ʦi [b|v]akian i naʦiɾa
S.TRANSL: 昨天，我去部落拜訪爺爺。
Yesterday, I went to visit my grandpa in the tribe.

S.FORM: Matenesay tu kami a caay kasasuaraw, maurun tu kaku i ciraan.
Matenesay tu kami a caay kasasuaraw, maurun tu kaku i ciraan.
S.PHON: matənəsaj t[o|u] kami a ʦaaj kasas[o|u]araw ma[o|u]r[o|u]n t[o|u] kak[o|u] i ʦiraan
S.TRANSL: 我們很久沒有見面了，我很想念他。
We haven’t seen each other for a long time and I miss him a lot.

S.FORM: Melaw saan ci vaki i takuwan, pakaenan kaku tu ciyak, pananuman aca kaku tu ociya.
Melaw saan ci vaki i takuwan, pakaenan kaku tu ciyak, pananuman aca kaku tu ociya.
S.PHON: məɾaw saan ʦi [b|v]aki i tak[o|u]wan pakaənan kak[o|u] t[o|u] ʦijak panan[o|u]man aʦa kak[o|u] t[o|u] oʦija
S.TRANSL: 爺爺一看到我，就請我吃西瓜，請我喝茶。
As soon as grandpa saw me, he invited me to eat watermelon and drink tea.
